parameters.description:
`sinch-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `sinch_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Sinch URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters (the `api_key_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's Bearer access token). Sinch runs a separate API per region; if your account is not in the US region (the default), set SINCH_SMS_BASE_URL to your region's API, e.g. https://eu.sms.api.sinch.com (also au., br., ca.).
parameters.summary: Relay an SMS through your own Sinch account by posting a native Sinch SMS payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Bearer access token

service_plan_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's SINCH_SMS_SERVICE_PLAN_ID value (same format as SINCH_SMS_SERVICE_PLAN_ID)
